rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday description of someone who is accommodating and willing to negotiate.

example.english: He is conciliatory; we just need to sit down and talk.
example.traditional: 佢個人好商量，大家坐低傾吓就得。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 soeng1 loeng4 daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 king1 haa5 zau6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is specifically on being willing to make concessions.

example.english: Both sides are conciliatory and willing to make concessions, so the contract can be signed.
example.traditional: 今次雙方都肯讓步，份合約先至簽得成。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 soeng1 fong1 dou1 hang2 joeng6 bou6 fan2 hap6 joek3 sin1 zi3 cim1 dak1 sing4

rows.note: Use this for a placating approach aimed at calming a dispute and avoiding further trouble, often with a slightly disapproving shade.

example.english: They are conciliatory because they do not want the matter to get bigger, and they ask everyone to give a little.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔想件事鬧大，成日息事寧人，叫大家各退一步。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 soeng2 gin6 si6 naau6 daai6 seng4 jat6 sik1 si6 ning4 jan4 giu3 daai6 gaa1 gok3 teoi3 jat1 bou6
